records.description: Rank-average ensemble of RF, LightGBM and CatBoost on RDKit descriptors plus Morgan counts.
Append 1024-bin atom-pair count fingerprints to the descriptor and Morgan features used by the ensemble.
Change the random forest to bootstrap with max_samples=0.6 and 600 trees for more decorrelated trees.
Replace the rank-average with a logistic-regression stacker over inner 5-fold OOF predictions of RF, LightGBM and a scaled logistic regression.
Add a Tanimoto-kernel SVC on Morgan count fingerprints as a fourth rank-averaged ensemble member alongside RF, LightGBM and CatBoost.
Replace the mixed-feature ensemble with three random forests, each on its own view (descriptors, Morgan counts, atom-pair counts), rank-averaged.
Append 1024-bit RDKit path fingerprints (maxPath=5) to the descriptor and Morgan features. The shared feature matrix is used, so all three models see them and not only the RF.

issues: Nothing in the diff gets around the measurement. There is no file or network access, no hardcoded answers and no use of test labels. The change only adds monotone constraints to the LGBM model, which is fit on training data only.

Possible bug, not enough for a veto: mono[names.index(n)] assumes the RDKit descriptors start at column 0 of X, in descList order. The diff doesn't show featurize. If the descriptors come after the Morgan bits, or are filtered or reordered, the -1 constraints land on the wrong columns, such as fingerprint bits, and the edit doesn't do what it intends. It would also raise an IndexError if X has fewer columns than the descriptor index. The score is still valid either way, and the job ran without crashing.

The numbers match the provisional reject. The candidate scored 0.0942 against an incumbent of 0.0942, with 1 run each, so there is no measurable gain. From the rounded values z is about 0, which agrees with the reported z = 0.003; the gap is rounding. The change adds code complexity for no gain, so rejecting it is consistent with the 'simpler is better' rule.

records.description: Use monotone-constrained LightGBM (non-increasing in TPSA, NumHDonors, fr_COO) while keeping RF and CatBoost.
Add an RBF SVC on standardized, clipped RDKit descriptors as a fourth rank-averaged ensemble member alongside RF, LightGBM and CatBoost.
Replace the full descriptor and Morgan features with about 14 hand-picked BBB physchem descriptors (including SMARTS acid/base counts and charge counts) and a single shallow LightGBM model.
Replace the RF/LightGBM/CatBoost ensemble with a single CatBoost (600 iters, depth 6, lr 0.05) on RDKit descriptors plus 1024-bit Morgan counts.
Bag the RF/LightGBM/CatBoost ensemble over 3 seeds (CatBoost reduced to 300 iterations), featurizing once and rank-averaging all nine predictions.
Keep the largest fragment and neutralize charges with rdMolStandardize.Uncharger before computing fingerprints and descriptors.
Append 167 MACCS keys to the descriptor and Morgan count features used by the ensemble.
Use only RDKit descriptors (no Morgan fingerprint) with a single 500-tree random forest.
Add a Tanimoto kNN scorer on binary Morgan bits and an MLP on quantile-scaled descriptors as two extra rank-averaged members.
Add a Tanimoto kNN scorer on binary Morgan bits and an MLP on quantile-scaled descriptors as two extra rank-averaged members.
Drop feature columns nonzero in fewer than 10 training molecules or with variance under 0.005 before fitting the ensemble.
Add an ExtraTreesClassifier (500 trees, max_features=0.3) as a fourth rank-averaged ensemble member on the same features.
Replace the 2048-bit Morgan count fingerprint with a 1024-bit feature-invariant (FCFP-like) Morgan count fingerprint, concatenated with the RDKit descriptors.
Append 12 acid/base ionization SMARTS match counts (including a zwitterion flag) to the descriptor and Morgan features in featurize.
Add an XGBoost classifier (depth 4, 500 trees) on RDKit descriptors plus MACCS keys as a fourth rank-averaged ensemble member, leaving the other three models' features unchanged.
Swap LightGBM for a depth-4 XGBoost and add a HistGradientBoosting member on descriptor columns only to the rank-averaged ensemble.

issues: No cheating found: the HistGradientBoosting model trains only on the training fold (X, y), uses the seed, and its predictions are ranked like the other models'.

X[:, :nd] assumes the RDKit descriptor columns come first in X. The diff alone doesn't show this. If they don't, the new model trains on fingerprint bits. The score would still be honest but would not test what the edit claims.
Recomputed z = (0.0942 - 0.0949) / (0.0049 * sqrt(2)) = -0.101. The harness's -0.107 is within rounding error of the 4-decimal losses, so the numbers agree.
The difference is far inside the noise and the edit adds code and a fifth model for no gain, so rejecting is correct.

records.description: Add a HistGradientBoostingClassifier on the RDKit descriptor columns as a fourth rank-averaged ensemble member.
Keep the largest fragment and neutralize charges (with fallback to the original molecule) before featurizing, replicating slot 12.
Set the random forest to 800 trees, min_samples_leaf 2 and max_features 'sqrt' for smoother probabilities.
Add Tanimoto kNN and MLP members and blend all five by weights tuned on scaffold-grouped inner 5-fold OOF AUROC, shrunk 50% toward uniform.
Use Morgan radius 1 with 1024 count bits plus descriptors instead of radius 2 with 2048 bits.
Add a QuantileTransformer + RBF SVC (decision_function) on descriptor columns as a fourth rank-averaged ensemble member.
Random forest uses descriptors plus MACCS keys (no Morgan) with max_features=0.5 and 600 trees, while LightGBM and CatBoost keep descriptors plus Morgan.
Blend 50/50 by rank the existing RF/LightGBM/CatBoost ensemble with a logistic regression (C=0.1) on standardized, ±5 sd clipped RDKit descriptors.

issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. There is no file or network access, no pasted answers and no use of test labels. The new ExtraTreesClassifier gets the harness seed through random_state=seed.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. The weights list has 4 entries, which assumes the ensemble now has exactly 4 models (RF, ET, LGBM, CatBoost). If the hidden part of the file has a different number of models, np.average raises an error and the job crashes. It would not give a wrong score silently. The ranks are still computed on test predictions only, so that part is fine.

My z does not exactly match the reported one. With one run per side, z = (0.0942 - 0.094) / (0.0049 * sqrt(2)) ≈ 0.029, while the report says 0.026. The difference probably comes from the harness using unrounded run values (0.094 looks rounded). Either way the change is within noise, so reject is the right call.
Simplicity: the change adds a fifth-type model and hand-set weights ([1,1,1,2]) for a gain of about 0.0002, which is 0.04 sd. Not worth the extra code and run time.

records.description: Add an ExtraTrees member (500 trees, max_features 0.3) and weight the rank average RF 1, ET 1, LGBM 1, CatBoost 2.
Append 167 MACCS keys and the 79 EState fingerprint counts to the descriptor and Morgan count features in featurize.
Replace the single radius-2 2048-bit Morgan count with concatenated radius-1 1024-bit and radius-3 2048-bit count fingerprints plus descriptors.
Append 79 EState fingerprint counts and a 512-bit topological torsion count fingerprint to the descriptor and Morgan features.
Abort: ExtraTrees as a fourth member was already tried in slots 18 and 31.

Append a small block of hand-picked BBB physchem features (TPSA, logP, MW, HBD/HBA, rotatable bonds, acid/basic amine/quaternary N counts, charge sum, Fsp3, TPSA/MW) to the existing descriptor and Morgan features.
Abort: 3-seed bagging of the whole ensemble was already tried in slot 11.
Add an XGBRanker (rank:pairwise, single group) on descriptors plus Morgan counts as a fourth rank-averaged ensemble member.

issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. There is no file or network access and no pasted answers. Test labels are never used. The QuantileTransformer is fit on the training fold only and then applied to the test fold. Test features are used only on the test side of the kernel (Kt), which is correct.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. The precomputed-kernel SVC is fit on the train-vs-train kernel and scored with the test-vs-train kernel, so the shapes and orientation are right. The SVC margins are rank-normalized like the other ensemble members, and seed is passed to the QuantileTransformer. One assumption I could not check from the diff: that featurize puts the descriptor columns first and leaves no NaN or inf values. The job finished without integrity flags, so this seems to hold.

Recomputed z = (0.0942 - 0.0944) / (0.0049 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/1)) = -0.029. The harness reported -0.025. The gap is consistent with the displayed values being rounded to 4 decimals (an unrounded gap of about 0.00017 gives -0.025). Either way the difference is far inside the noise.
The provisional reject is sound. The candidate is no better than the incumbent, and the added kernel-SVC code makes the script more complex for no gain, which the simplicity rule counts against.

records.description: Add a fourth rank-averaged member: precomputed-kernel SVC on 0.5*Tanimoto(min/max Morgan counts) + 0.5*RBF(quantile-scaled descriptors).
Add a precomputed-kernel SVC member (0.5*MinMax Tanimoto on Morgan counts + 0.5*RBF on quantile-scaled descriptors) to the rank-averaged ensemble.
Standardize molecules (largest fragment, neutralize) and add Tanimoto kNN and quantile-scaled MLP members to the rank-averaged ensemble.

memo: Helped: only the slot 0 rank-average ensemble of RF, LightGBM and CatBoost on descriptors plus Morgan counts (0.1361 to 0.0942). Nothing else was accepted, yet several rejected ideas beat noise (sd about 0.0049): slot 15 kNN plus MLP (0.0868 and 0.0853 over 2 runs, -0.0081), slot 12 largest fragment plus neutralization (0.0899, -0.0043), slot 24 (0.0904), slot 26 weighted five-member blend (0.0901). Adopt these. Not helpful: fingerprint additions (atom-pair, path, MACCS, FCFP, EState), stacking, extra tree/SVC/HGB members, RF tweaks, monotone constraints, seed bagging (all within about ±0.002). Hurt: physchem-only (+0.0381), descriptors-only RF (+0.0152), single CatBoost (+0.0079), per-view RFs (+0.0032), dropping rare columns (+0.0029), logistic regression blend (+0.0137). Next: make slot 15 the base, add slot 12 standardization, then replicate. Then tune CatBoost/LightGBM depth and regularization. Avoid more stacking and fingerprint additions.

incumbent.description: Rank-average ensemble of RF, LightGBM and CatBoost on RDKit descriptors plus Morgan counts.

backlog.spec: Compute all rdkit.Chem.Descriptors.descList values per molecule (np.nan_to_num, clip to +-1e6) and concatenate with the Morgan bits as RF input. BBB depends strongly on TPSA, MW, HBD, logP, so physchem descriptors should help.
backlog.title: Add RDKit 2D descriptors

backlog.spec: Replace the fingerprint with only the RDKit descriptor list (nan_to_num, clip), keep RandomForest with 500 trees. Tests whether fingerprints are just noise on scaffold splits.
backlog.title: Descriptors only RF

backlog.spec: Use GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy instead of bit vectors with radius 2 and 2048 bins, keeping the RF. Counts carry more information than bits.
backlog.title: Count Morgan fingerprints

backlog.spec: Use LGBMClassifier (n_estimators=400, learning_rate=0.03, num_leaves=15, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.5, min_child_samples=10, random_state=seed, n_jobs=8, verbose=-1) on RDKit descriptors plus a few Morgan count features.
backlog.title: LightGBM on descriptors

backlog.spec: Use CatBoostClassifier(iterations=600, depth=6, learning_rate=0.05, random_seed=seed, thread_count=8, verbose=0) on RDKit descriptors concatenated with 1024-bit Morgan counts.
backlog.title: CatBoost on descriptors

backlog.spec: Swap RF for ExtraTreesClassifier (500 trees, max_features=0.3, n_jobs=-1) on descriptors plus Morgan bits.
backlog.title: ExtraTrees with descriptors

backlog.spec: Average rank-normalized probabilities (scipy.stats.rankdata) from RF, LightGBM, and CatBoost, all trained on descriptors plus Morgan counts.
backlog.title: RF+LGBM+CatBoost ensemble

backlog.spec: Append the 167 MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys) to the feature set (Morgan bits plus descriptors) for the RF.
backlog.title: MACCS keys addition

backlog.spec: Use Morgan radius 1 with 1024 counts, plus descriptors. Smaller substructures generalize better across scaffolds.
backlog.title: Smaller radius-1 Morgan with features

backlog.spec: Use a Morgan generator with atomInvariantsGenerator=GetMorganFeatureAtomInvGen(), radius 2, 1024 counts, concatenated with descriptors. Pharmacophoric atom types are more scaffold-agnostic.
backlog.title: Feature-Morgan invariants (FCFP)

backlog.spec: Add 1024-bin atom-pair count fingerprints (rdFingerprintGenerator.GetAtomPairGenerator) to the features along with descriptors for an RF.
backlog.title: Atom-pair count fingerprints

backlog.spec: Set N_TREES=800, MIN_SAMPLES_LEAF=2, and max_features='sqrt' on the current features. Smoother probabilities may improve AUROC.
backlog.title: RF min_samples_leaf 2 and more trees

backlog.spec: Use class_weight='balanced_subsample' in the RF; the BBB data is imbalanced toward positives.
backlog.title: Balanced class weights

backlog.spec: Standardize descriptors (clip to +-5 sd) and fit LogisticRegression(C=0.1, max_iter=2000). Blend 50/50 by rank with the RF probabilities.
backlog.title: Logistic regression on scaled descriptors

backlog.spec: Use SVC(kernel='rbf', C=1, probability=True, random_state=seed) on standardized, clipped descriptors; blend with RF by averaging.
backlog.title: SVM RBF on descriptors

backlog.spec: Compute a Tanimoto kernel on Morgan count/bit fingerprints between train and test and fit SVC(kernel='precomputed', C=1, probability=True). Blend with the descriptor RF.
backlog.title: Tanimoto-kernel SVM

backlog.spec: Use XGBClassifier(n_estimators=500, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.03, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.4, min_child_weight=2, n_jobs=8, random_state=seed) on descriptors plus MACCS.
backlog.title: XGBoost on descriptors plus MACCS

backlog.spec: Use only about 12 hand-picked descriptors (TPSA, MolWt, MolLogP, NumHDonors, NumHAcceptors, NumRotatableBonds, FractionCSP3, formal charge counts, ring count, acid and base group counts via SMARTS) with a gradient boosting classifier. Low-variance, BBB-rule driven.
backlog.title: Small curated physchem set

backlog.spec: Add counts of carboxylic acids, sulfonamides, quaternary N, basic amines, and phenols via SMARTS matches to descriptors+Morgan features for the RF.
backlog.title: Acid/base SMARTS counts

backlog.spec: Train the descriptor+Morgan RF with 3 different random_state values derived from the seed, with 300 trees each, and average. Reduces variance.
backlog.title: Multi-seed bagging

backlog.spec: Drop columns that are nonzero in fewer than 10 train molecules (or have variance under 0.005) before fitting the RF, so max_features sampling picks informative features more often.
backlog.title: Feature selection by frequency

backlog.spec: Before featurizing, keep the largest fragment (rdkit.Chem.rdmolops.GetMolFrags asMols, max by atom count) and neutralize charges with rdMolStandardize.Uncharger. Standardizes inputs for both fingerprints and descriptors.
backlog.title: Salt stripping and neutralization

backlog.spec: Use sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=300, learning_rate=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=15, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=seed) on descriptors; blend with the RF by mean.
backlog.title: HistGradientBoosting on descriptors

backlog.spec: Add EState index counts and sums (rdkit.Chem.EState.Fingerprinter.FingerprintMol) as features alongside descriptors for LightGBM.
backlog.title: EState fingerprint features

backlog.spec: Inside fit_predict, get out-of-fold predictions of RF, LightGBM, and logistic regression using 5-fold CV on training data, then fit a logistic regression meta learner and apply it to test predictions.
backlog.title: Stacked logistic blend with inner CV

backlog.spec: Use RF with bootstrap=True, max_samples=0.6 and 600 trees on descriptors+Morgan counts for more decorrelated trees.
backlog.title: RF with max_samples subsampling

backlog.spec: Train separate RFs on Morgan counts, atom-pair counts, and descriptors, and average predictions by rank. Diverse views help under scaffold shift.
backlog.title: Rank average of RFs on different views

backlog.spec: Compute the Murcko scaffold per train molecule and weight each sample by 1/sqrt(scaffold group size) in RF fit via sample_weight, preventing large scaffold families from dominating.
backlog.title: Scaffold-aware sample weights

backlog.spec: Add 1024-bit RDKit topological path fingerprints (rdFingerprintGenerator.GetRDKitFPGenerator, maxPath=5) to descriptors for the RF.
backlog.title: RDKit path fingerprint addition

backlog.spec: On descriptors plus MACCS, set RF max_features=0.5, n_estimators=600, min_samples_leaf=1. Higher fraction suits dense, informative descriptors.
backlog.title: RF on descriptors+MACCS higher max_features

backlog.spec: In featurize, add a small block of hand-picked BBB-relevant features appended to the existing ones: TPSA, MolLogP, MolWt, NumHDonors, NumHAcceptors, NumRotatableBonds, count of carboxylic acids (SMARTS C(=O)[OH,O-]), count of basic amines (SMARTS [NX3;!$(N-C=O);!$(N-S=O);!$(N-a)]), formal charge sum, fraction sp3, and TPSA/MolWt. Also add quaternary N+ count. Keep everything else unchanged.
backlog.title: Curated physchem feature subset for BBB

backlog.spec: Replace the LGBMClassifier with one using monotone_constraints so that probability is non-increasing in TPSA, NumHDonors and carboxylic acid count (find these column indices from [n for n,_ in Descriptors.descList]; set 0 for all other columns, length = X.shape[1]). This injects the known BBB prior and reduces variance on unseen scaffolds. Keep the other two models.
backlog.title: Monotone-constrained LightGBM on TPSA/HBD

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, wrap the model list in a loop over 3 seeds (seed, seed+1, seed+2), fitting each of RF, LGBM, CatBoost with that seed and rank-averaging all predictions. Reduce CatBoost iterations to 300 if needed to stay within the 10 min limit. Featurize only once.
backlog.title: Multi-seed bagging of the ensemble

backlog.spec: After featurizing train and test, compute on the training matrix a mask keeping columns with variance>0 and, for the Morgan count part, nonzero in at least 10 training molecules (descriptor columns always kept unless constant). Also drop descriptor columns with absolute Pearson correlation >0.98 against an earlier kept column. Apply the mask to both X and Xt before fitting all models.
backlog.title: Remove near-constant and correlated features

backlog.spec: Change the CatBoost member to depth=4, iterations=800, learning_rate=0.03, l2_leaf_reg=10, rsm=0.2, random_strength=2, and bootstrap_type='Bernoulli' with subsample=0.7. Leave other models unchanged. Aim at better generalization to unseen scaffolds.
backlog.title: Shallow CatBoost with strong regularization

backlog.spec: Add a fourth ensemble member: sklearn Pipeline of QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal', n_quantiles=200) on the descriptor columns only (first len(Descriptors.descList) columns), then SVC(kernel='rbf', C=1, gamma='scale', probability=False) and use decision_function as the score, rank-averaged with the others. Gives a smooth model with a different inductive bias than trees.
backlog.title: Add a descriptor-based RBF SVM member

backlog.spec: Compute the Murcko scaffold of each training molecule (rdkit.Chem.Scaffolds.MurckoScaffold.MurckoScaffoldSmiles) and give each sample weight 1/sqrt(count of its scaffold in the training set), normalized to mean 1. Pass sample_weight to RF, LGBM, and CatBoost fits. This downweights over-represented series so models generalise to new skeletons.
backlog.title: Scaffold-diversity sample weights

backlog.spec: After fitting the ensemble and obtaining rank-averaged test predictions, take the test molecules with the most confident predictions (top 20% and bottom 20% by score) as pseudo-labeled 1/0, append them to the training set, refit all models, and return the final rank-averaged predictions. Transductive adaptation to unseen scaffolds; keep code compact via a helper function that fits and predicts.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training with test molecules

backlog.spec: In featurize, before computing descriptors and fingerprints, apply rdkit.Chem.MolStandardize.rdMolStandardize: LargestFragmentChooser then Uncharger to each molecule, falling back to the original on error. This removes salt counterions that add noise to descriptors for BBB labels.
backlog.title: Stripped, neutralized molecules with largest fragment

backlog.spec: Add ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=500, max_features=0.3, min_samples_leaf=1, n_jobs=-1, random_state=seed) as a fourth ensemble member, and weight the rank average as RF 1, ET 1, LGBM 1, CatBoost 2 using np.average with weights. Keeps trees but adds randomized-split diversity.
backlog.title: Add ExtraTrees and drop weaker members via rank weights

backlog.spec: In featurize, before computing descriptors and fingerprints, parse the molecule, keep only the largest fragment with rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser, and neutralize charges with rdMolStandardize.Uncharger. Fall back to the original molecule if any step fails. Everything else stays unchanged. This removes counter-ion noise from the descriptors.
backlog.title: Salt stripping and largest-fragment neutralization

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, compute features once. Then train the RF, LightGBM and CatBoost trio 3 times with seeds seed, seed+1 and seed+2. Rank-average all 9 predictions. Reduce CatBoost iterations to 400 if needed to stay under the 10 minute limit. This is a variance reduction change only.
backlog.title: Multi-seed bagging of the whole ensemble

backlog.spec: Add ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=500, max_features=0.3, min_samples_leaf=1, n_jobs=-1, random_state=seed) as a fourth model in the rank-averaged ensemble. It uses the same features X.
backlog.title: Add ExtraTrees member

backlog.spec: After featurizing the training set in fit_predict, compute a column mask on X. Keep columns with nonzero variance and with at least 10 nonzero entries. Also drop descriptor columns that are exactly duplicated, using np.unique on the columns. Apply the same mask to Xt. Train the ensemble on the reduced features.
backlog.title: Drop near-constant and duplicate features

backlog.spec: Change CatBoost to depth=4, l2_leaf_reg=10, iterations=800, learning_rate=0.03, rsm=0.2. Change LightGBM to num_leaves=8, min_child_samples=20, reg_lambda=5, n_estimators=500, learning_rate=0.03. Keep the RF unchanged.
backlog.title: Shallow strongly regularized CatBoost and LightGBM

backlog.spec: Append the 167 MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys) and the 79 EState_FP bits (rdkit.Chem.EState.Fingerprinter.FingerprintMol, counts part) to the feature vector in featurize. Make no other changes.
backlog.title: Add MACCS keys and EState fingerprint features

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, fit the current ensemble once and get rank-averaged probabilities for the test molecules. Take the most confident test molecules, with probability above 0.85 or below 0.15, and label them 1 or 0. Append them to the training set with sample_weight 0.5, and refit the ensemble. Use the second-round predictions as the output. Use sample_weight in fit for all three models.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training on test molecules

backlog.spec: Use class_weight='balanced_subsample' in the RF. Use is_unbalance=True in LGBMClassifier. Use auto_class_weights='Balanced' in CatBoost. Keep the rank-average.
backlog.title: Class-balanced weights

backlog.spec: Add two rank-averaged members. The first is a kNN-style scorer on binary Morgan fingerprints. For each test molecule, take the Tanimoto-weighted mean label of its 10 most similar training molecules. The second is an sklearn MLPClassifier (hidden_layer_sizes=(256,64), alpha=1e-2, early_stopping=True, random_state=seed) on QuantileTransformer-scaled descriptors. The two members add diversity that tree models lack.
backlog.title: Add a kNN Tanimoto member plus an MLP on scaled descriptors

backlog.spec: In featurize, before computing descriptors and fingerprints, parse each SMILES, keep the largest fragment with rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser(), then neutralize with rdMolStandardize.Uncharger(). Fall back to the original molecule if any step fails. Leave the rest of the ensemble unchanged. This replicates the best sub-noise result (0.0899) to check whether it holds.
backlog.title: Fragment-stripped plus neutralized molecules (replicate slot 12)

backlog.spec: Append about 12 SMARTS match counts to the features in featurize: carboxylic acid, tetrazole, sulfonamide NH, phenol, aliphatic primary/secondary/tertiary amine, amidine/guanidine, quaternary N, pyridine-type N, quaternary or charged atoms, and basic-amine-plus-acid zwitterion flag. Use Chem.MolFromSmarts and len(m.GetSubstructMatches(p)). Charge state is a key BBB driver and is only weakly captured by the current features.
backlog.title: Acid/base ionization SMARTS counts

backlog.spec: Add sklearn ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=500, max_features=0.3, min_samples_leaf=1, n_jobs=-1, random_state=seed) as a fourth rank-averaged member in fit_predict. It is a more randomized, smoother learner than RF and should add diversity cheaply.
backlog.title: Add ExtraTrees member

backlog.spec: Change LightGBM to num_leaves=8, min_child_samples=20, reg_lambda=5, n_estimators=500, learning_rate=0.03, and CatBoost to depth=4, l2_leaf_reg=10, iterations=800. Small data with scaffold splits favors low-capacity boosters. Keep the RF as is.
backlog.title: Shallow strongly regularized boosters

backlog.spec: After the first ensemble prediction, take test molecules with rank-averaged score in the top 15% or bottom 15%, assign them hard labels 1 and 0, and add them to the training set with sample_weight 0.5. Refit all models and return the final predictions. Because this is transductive, it adapts to the unseen scaffolds. Note that the score is rank-based, so the top/bottom fraction is relative to the test set. Use a class-prior-aware cut if needed.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training on test molecules

backlog.spec: Set class_weight='balanced_subsample' for the RF, is_unbalance=True for LightGBM and auto_class_weights='Balanced' for CatBoost. Also drop columns with zero variance on the training set, computed in fit_predict and applied to both X and Xt. Both changes are small regularization tweaks.
backlog.title: Class-balanced weights with feature dedup

backlog.spec: In featurize, replace the Morgan generator with rdFingerprintGenerator.GetMorganGenerator(radius=2, fpSize=2048, atomInvariantsGenerator=rdFingerprintGenerator.GetMorganFeatureAtomInvGen()). Functional-class invariants generalize better across scaffolds than exact atom environments. Keep the descriptors.
backlog.title: FCFP feature-Morgan counts replacing ECFP

backlog.spec: Combine slot 15's members (Tanimoto kNN on Morgan bits plus an MLP on quantile-scaled descriptors) with the RF, LGBM and CatBoost trio, and with slot 12's cleaning. Use equal-weight rank averaging, with no stacking. Slot 15 got 0.0868/0.0853, the best raw result, so this stacks the two best signals. The MLP is sklearn MLPClassifier(hidden_layer_sizes=(256,64), alpha=1e-2, early_stopping=True, random_state=seed), bagged over 3 seeds.
backlog.title: Bold: rank-weighted blend tuned by inner scaffold CV, adding kNN and MLP

backlog.spec: Replace LGBMClassifier with XGBClassifier(n_estimators=400, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.05, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.3, min_child_weight=2, reg_lambda=5, tree_method='hist', n_jobs=8, random_state=seed). Its depth-wise growth and regularization differ from LightGBM's leaf-wise growth, so it may be less prone to overfitting.
backlog.title: Bold: XGBoost on descriptors plus counts, replacing LightGBM

backlog.spec: In train.py, standardize each molecule before featurizing: keep the largest fragment (rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser) and neutralize with rdMolStandardize.Uncharger, falling back to the original mol on failure. Then add two extra rank-averaged members to the RF/LGBM/CatBoost ensemble: a Tanimoto kNN scorer (k=10, similarity-weighted vote) on binary Morgan bits, and an sklearn MLPClassifier (hidden 256,64, alpha 1e-2, early_stopping, max_iter 300) on QuantileTransformer-scaled descriptors. Combine all five by mean of ranks.
backlog.title: Adopt kNN + MLP members with fragment cleanup

backlog.spec: Inside fit_predict, compute inner 5-fold GroupKFold OOF predictions (groups = Murcko scaffold) for each ensemble member (RF, LGBM, CatBoost, kNN Tanimoto, MLP), then choose non-negative blend weights by maximizing OOF AUROC with scipy.optimize (or a coarse simplex grid), refit members on all training data, and combine ranks with these weights. Shrink weights 50% toward uniform for stability.
backlog.title: Scaffold-grouped inner CV weight tuning

backlog.spec: After the first ensemble prediction, take the top 15% and bottom 15% most confident test molecules by averaged rank, add them to the training set with hard labels (sample weight 0.5 where supported), refit all members, and return the new rank-average blended 50/50 with the first-round prediction.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training on test molecules

backlog.spec: Replace the single radius-2 2048-bit Morgan count with the concatenation of radius-1 (512 bits) and radius-3 (1024 bits) count fingerprints, with the descriptors kept. Different per-model views through the existing feature matrix only.
backlog.title: Radius-1 plus radius-3 Morgan count multi-scale

backlog.spec: Append the EState fingerprint counts (rdkit.Chem.EState.Fingerprinter.FingerprintMol, counts vector of 79) and a 512-bit topological torsion count fingerprint from rdFingerprintGenerator.GetTopologicalTorsionGenerator to the feature matrix. Keep everything else the same.
backlog.title: Add EState and topological torsion features

backlog.spec: Swap LightGBM for an XGBClassifier (hist, max_depth=4, n_estimators=600, learning_rate=0.03, subsample=0.7, colsample_bytree=0.3, min_child_weight=2, reg_lambda=3, n_jobs=8) trained on the same features, and add sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier (max_leaf_nodes=15, l2_regularization=1, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=300) on descriptors only as an extra rank-averaged member.
backlog.title: Replace LightGBM with HistGradientBoosting + XGBoost dart mix

backlog.spec: Augment training data: for each training molecule add one copy whose RDKit descriptor columns are multiplied by (1+0.03*N(0,1)) using seeded RNG, with fingerprint columns unchanged and same label. Fit all members on the doubled set. Acts as a smoothing regularizer.
backlog.title: Descriptor noise augmentation of training set

backlog.spec: Add a LGBMRanker-free alternative: train CatBoost with loss_function='YetiRank' is not applicable, so instead use CatBoostClassifier with loss_function='Logloss', auto_class_weights='Balanced', depth 8, iterations 400, rsm 0.1 as an additional rank-averaged member, adding diversity through deeper trees and balanced weights.
backlog.title: Pairwise-rank objective with LightGBM ranker members

backlog.spec: In featurize and fit_predict, first standardize each molecule: keep the largest fragment (rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser) and neutralize with rdMolStandardize.Uncharger, falling back to the original mol on any exception. Then add two more rank-averaged members to the RF/LightGBM/CatBoost ensemble: a Tanimoto kNN scorer (k=10, similarity-weighted vote) on binary Morgan bits, and an sklearn MLPClassifier (hidden 256,64, alpha 1e-2, early_stopping, random_state=seed) on QuantileTransformer-scaled descriptors. Rank-average all five equally. This combines the slot 12/24 and slot 15 gains.
backlog.title: Fragment cleanup plus kNN and MLP members

backlog.spec: Before fitting the tree models, augment the training set with one extra copy of the training rows in which the RDKit descriptor columns are multiplied by (1 + 0.05*N(0,1)) noise drawn from np.random.RandomState(seed). Keep the fingerprint columns and labels unchanged. Fit the RF, LightGBM and CatBoost on the doubled set. Predict on the clean test features.
backlog.title: Descriptor noise augmentation

backlog.spec: After the initial ensemble prediction on the test set, take the 20% most confident test molecules at each end (rank-average score top and bottom). Add them to the training set with hard labels 1/0 and sample weight 0.5 (RF, LightGBM and CatBoost all support sample_weight). Refit all three models and predict again. Return the rank average of the second-round predictions.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training on test molecules

backlog.spec: Replace the single radius-2 2048-bit Morgan count fingerprint with the concatenation of radius-1 (512 bits) and radius-3 (2048 bits) count fingerprints, keeping the RDKit descriptors. The aim is to capture both small functional groups and larger environments.
backlog.title: Multi-scale Morgan counts (r1 and r3)

backlog.spec: Add a LightGBM LGBMRanker (objective lambdarank, or rank_xendcg) as an extra rank-averaged member. Put all training molecules in a single group with the 0/1 labels as relevance, n_estimators=300, learning_rate=0.05, colsample_bytree=0.3, num_leaves=15. It optimizes ranking directly, which suits an AUROC loss. Use predict output for rank averaging.
backlog.title: Pairwise-rank LightGBM members

backlog.spec: Add a member using sklearn SVC with kernel='precomputed' on a combined kernel. The kernel is 0.5*Tanimoto (MinMax on Morgan counts) + 0.5*RBF on QuantileTransformer-scaled descriptors (gamma=1/n_features). Use probability=False, C=1, and take decision_function as the score. Rank-average with the three existing models. Fit the scaler on the training set only.
backlog.title: Bold: Gaussian-process style kernel ridge on combined kernels

backlog.spec: Set class_weight='balanced_subsample' for the RF, is_unbalance=True for LightGBM and auto_class_weights='Balanced' for CatBoost. Keep all else the same. This tests whether the minority class gets better ranking on unseen scaffolds.
backlog.title: Balanced class weights across the ensemble

backlog.spec: In featurize/fit_predict, first parse each SMILES, keep the largest fragment (rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser) and neutralize with rdMolStandardize.Uncharger, falling back to the original molecule on any exception. Then add two members to the rank-averaged ensemble: a Tanimoto kNN scorer (k=10, similarity-weighted mean of neighbor labels) on binary Morgan bits, and an sklearn MLPClassifier (hidden 256,64, alpha 1e-2, early_stopping, max_iter 300, random_state=seed) on QuantileTransformer-scaled descriptors with constant columns removed. Rank-average all five equally with RF, LightGBM and CatBoost.
backlog.title: Adopt fragment cleanup, kNN and MLP together

backlog.spec: Augment the training set by appending one extra copy of the training matrix in which the descriptor columns (not the fingerprint columns) are perturbed by Gaussian noise of 5% of each column's standard deviation, using np.random.RandomState(seed). Labels are duplicated. Train all models on the doubled data.
backlog.title: Descriptor noise augmentation

backlog.spec: Set class_weight='balanced_subsample' on the RandomForest, is_unbalance=True on LGBMClassifier, and auto_class_weights='Balanced' on CatBoostClassifier. Keep everything else the same.
backlog.title: Balanced class weights across ensemble

backlog.spec: Replace the single radius-2 2048-bit Morgan count with the concatenation of a radius-1 1024-bit count fingerprint and a radius-3 2048-bit count fingerprint (separate generators) alongside the descriptors.
backlog.title: Multi-scale Morgan counts r1 and r3

backlog.spec: Add a LightGBM LGBMRanker-free variant: an LGBMClassifier with objective='binary' replaced by an XGBClassifier using objective='rank:pairwise' is not supported in sklearn style, so instead use xgboost.XGBRanker(objective='rank:pairwise', n_estimators=400, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.05, colsample_bytree=0.3, subsample=0.8) with all training rows in one group, fit on descriptors plus Morgan counts, and add its rank-transformed scores as a fourth member of the rank average.
backlog.title: Pairwise-rank LightGBM member

backlog.spec: Add a member: precompute the kernel K = 0.5*Tanimoto(Morgan count minmax) + 0.5*RBF on quantile-scaled descriptors (gamma=1/n_features), fit sklearn KernelRidge(alpha=1.0, kernel='precomputed') on y in {-1,1}, predict on test via the cross kernel, and add its rank to the equal-weight rank average with RF, LightGBM and CatBoost.
backlog.title: Kernel ridge on combined Tanimoto and descriptor RBF kernel

backlog.spec: After the first ensemble prediction on test_smiles, take the test molecules with rank-averaged probability above the 0.8 quantile as positives and below the 0.2 quantile as negatives, add them to the training set with sample_weight 0.5 (RF and LightGBM accept sample_weight, as does CatBoost), refit all models once, and return the rank average of the refit predictions.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training on test molecules

backlog.spec: Before fitting, augment the training set with 1 extra copy of X whose descriptor columns (the first len(Descriptors.descList) columns) get Gaussian noise with sd equal to 0.05 times each column's training std (rng seeded by seed). Keep the fingerprint columns and labels unchanged. Fit all models on the doubled set.
backlog.title: Descriptor noise augmentation

backlog.spec: Add a fourth member: KernelRidge-style classifier via sklearn SVC(kernel='precomputed') or KernelRidge(alpha=1) with kernel K = 0.5*Tanimoto(Morgan count minmax) + 0.5*RBF on QuantileTransformer-scaled descriptors (gamma=1/n_features). Use decision values on test, rank-normalize, and add to the equal-weight rank average.
backlog.title: Kernel ridge on combined Tanimoto and descriptor RBF kernel

backlog.spec: Replace the single radius-2 2048-bit Morgan count with the concatenation of a radius-1 1024-bit count FP and a radius-3 2048-bit count FP, plus the descriptors. Leave models unchanged.
backlog.title: Multi-scale Morgan counts r1 and r3 with larger bit space

backlog.spec: Set class_weight='balanced_subsample' on the RF, is_unbalance=True on LightGBM, and auto_class_weights='Balanced' on CatBoost. Rank averaging stays the same.
backlog.title: Balanced class weights across ensemble

backlog.spec: Add the Tanimoto kNN and quantile-scaled-descriptor MLP members. Compute inner out-of-fold predictions with GroupKFold(4) grouped by Murcko scaffold on the training set. Grid-search nonnegative blend weights over a coarse simplex (steps of 0.25) maximizing OOF AUROC, then apply these weights to the rank-averaged test predictions from models refit on all the training data.
backlog.title: Weighted blend tuned by scaffold-grouped inner CV with kNN and MLP

backlog.spec: Add a CatBoostRegressor member (depth 6, 600 iterations, lr 0.05, rsm 0.2, RMSE loss) trained on the 0/1 labels smoothed by a 10-nearest-neighbour Tanimoto label average (y_soft = 0.5*y + 0.5*mean of neighbours' y, excluding self). Rank-average its predictions as a fourth equal-weight member.
backlog.title: Bold: Gaussian-process-like rank-transform target with CatBoost regressor ensemble
